C0428.title: Bilibili Streamer Destroys Viewer's Account Over Expired Membership
C0428.summary: In March 2026, Bilibili streamer 'Qingyu' destroyed all rare virtual items on a fan's account after the fan's paid membership status lapsed while logged in via QR code scan. The incident highlights the potential damage when others gain account access through scan-based login mechanisms.

references.title: Bilibili Streamer's Latest Scandal Angers All Netizens
